compositionOwner.name: BuildsHomePage
compositionOwner.responsibility: compose exactly the page header, class selector, four-card command deck, and shared product tab bar; no overview, workspace, duplicate list, or workflow timeline

contract.topology: one first-level title with one right-side component slot for the separate class selector owner

contract.closedTopology: one compact pill containing canonical class icon, class name, and disclosure chevron
contract.openTopology: bottom sheet titled 选择职业 with a three-column grid of all canonical classes
interactions: choosing an enabled class saves it, closes the sheet, and updates the single selected class
closing or cancelling preserves the current class
contract.selectionInvariant: exactly one available class cell owns the gold selected material; the selected outline is inset and cannot change any cell or closed-pill bounds

contract.topology: four vertically stacked equal peer cards; each whole card contains one medallion, title, one-line fixed description, and forward chevron
contract.interaction: the whole card navigates once; cards do not expand, reorder, or express steps

contract.topology: four equal columns; active visuals never change column width or label position
contract.nativeSafeArea: background reaches the physical screen bottom and controls remain above safeArea.bottom

layoutContract.rule: The ready state fits the 390x830 first viewport with all four commands visible; no business-content vertical scroll and no tab-bar overlap are allowed.
layoutContract.nativeSafeArea: AppShell and the shared TabBar remain the only safe-area owners; route-private code cannot resize target cards or add a second bottom inset

stateContract.readyTargetRule: the canonical bitmap represents only the closed-selector ready state
stateContract.loadingAndFailureRule: RouteStage owns loading, error, and blocked states outside the ready target; command cards never become readiness panels
stateContract.clippingRule: title, selector, all four cards, and shared tab labels remain inside their measured owners at the 390 CSS px baseline

componentCapabilityGaps: the current BuildsHomePage still publishes the superseded multi-region topology
implementationOrder: BuildClassSelector closed pill and three-column bottom sheet
target/runtime geometry and real WeChat interaction review
